svg.text: UML use case diagram. Primary actors and the major use cases at the system boundary. Identifiers match the low level use case tables.
Scan a badge at a gate
Identifiers are the UC numbers used by the low level use case tables in section 3.1.2, where each case carries its
preconditions, main flow, alternative flows, exception flows and postconditions. Cases reached only by redirect,
and administrative variants of the cases above, are held in those tables rather than drawn here.
